learner_operation: Translate a linear combination of three R^3 vectors into three scalar equations, solve by Gaussian elimination/back substitution or identify inconsistency, then evaluate the requested signed sum of coefficients.

fixed_features.feature: Three supplied vectors in R^3 and three coefficient unknowns
fixed_features.justification: Canonical example and all practice sources assess component translation and 3x3 elimination.

fixed_features.feature: A single scalar coefficient sum or signed sum, or inconsistency; five-choice radio response
fixed_features.justification: Complete observed source response contract; worked example alone lacks a bank.

fixed_features.feature: Source matrix profiles, elimination sequences and scalar targets
fixed_features.justification: Conservative domain preserves demonstrated arithmetic workload and source method. Values are not essential invariants; bounded RHS changes yield substantial same-method practice. Signed target is retained rather than claiming all target-expression mastery.

answer_roles.role: Correct numeric rank and displayed position
answer_roles.eligible_variation: Any numeric choice can carry the mathematically computed target, independent of matrix profile; any position can display it.
answer_roles.observed: All 33 eligible numeric anchors across 8 profiles verified at fixed prompts. Fresh sample and exact batch vary ranks and positions.

answer_roles.eligible_variation: Bounded integer coefficient triples including zero and both signs; derived RHS and answer must follow.
answer_roles.observed: 48 fresh moderate records plus signed/zero boundaries; relevant RHS pair changes 6 to 7; kernel perturbation preserves 6.

answer_roles.eligible_variation: Moderate sources uniquely solvable; hard sources inconsistent; all-plus and signed-sum source profiles.
answer_roles.observed: Both source difficulty families retained. Hard is a finite inconsistency exercise, not mixed consistency practice. No arbitrary label or bank layout carries that mathematical judgment.

coverage.case: Every eligible anchor at fixed data
coverage.result: 33 bank cases; all eligible numeric ranks correct within each of 8 recognizable matrix profiles; fixed prompts/solutions.

counterfactuals.expected: Target sum 6 -> 7; displayed prompt, worked substitution and accepted choice must follow.
counterfactuals.observed: Exact arithmetic gives 6 -> 7; both prompts/solutions rendered via actual UI and all choices checked by native grader; numeric rank changes 2 -> 3.
counterfactuals.justification: Changing x3 changes the requested sum; preserving a previous key would fail.

counterfactuals.expected: All-plus target stays 6 while vectors RHS and individual coefficient substitutions change.
counterfactuals.observed: Both exact solutions sum to 6; actual UI displays changed RHS and solution; native grader accepts only value 6 in each bank.
counterfactuals.justification: A*(1,-1,0) is in the kernel of the requested scalar sum, so this coefficient perturbation is irrelevant to the response.

counterfactuals.change: Hold A,b,target fixed and choose a different numeric bank anchor.
counterfactuals.expected: Mathematical answer, prompt and solution preserved; correct selection UUID and relative numeric rank follow the new bank.
counterfactuals.observed: All 33 bank cases obey this relationship; representative controlled pair rendered; all choices exercised by native grader.
counterfactuals.justification: Choice layout and distractor translation are incidental to the scalar target, so they may not determine it.
